content.short: Fluxion Network is a Mantle DEX for trading, voting, earning incentives, and community liquidity growth.
content.description: Fluxion Network is a decentralized exchange built for the Mantle ecosystem. The app combines token trading, liquidity incentives, and voting features so users and protocols can route swaps, provide liquidity, and participate in emissions or reward campaigns. Fluxion positions itself as a collaboration-focused DEX for Mantle communities, aiming to maximize liquidity depth and support sustainable growth for ecosystem tokens. By operating directly on Mantle, it gives users low-cost access to swaps and incentive programs without relying on centralized intermediaries.
